title: Publish v0.5.55 performance delivery for future adopters
outOfScope: Do not alter, recreate, or delete v0.5.50 or any earlier immutable tag, Release, or asset.
Do not lower test count, coverage, security, release, smoke, or installer gates.
Do not hand-edit generated release evidence, tags, Releases, or installer state.

sources.reason: Published projection currently declares v0.5.54 and its immutable archive contract.
Canonical state records the v0.5.55 pending provider-evidence transition.
Only authorized mechanism for rehearsal, immutable tag creation, asset validation, and publication.
Documents exact source, release-assets authority, and future-adopter verification rules.
Provider Release evidence: v0.5.55 is stable, targets ef000c8c, and contains the named release assets.
The documented default discovery endpoint still projects v0.5.54 after v0.5.55 publication and is the reproduced delivery gap.

riskAssessment.reason: Publishing an immutable public tag and installer assets is externally visible; the workflow, receipt, and post-publish installer verification must all bind to one exact source.

reasons: Public provider release requires strict identity and evidence verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized completing all Work Items through the corrected public release, future-adopter installation proof, and local/remote cleanup.

preReviewWarnings: Dispatch only the exact v0.5.55 candidate from synchronized origin/main after its same-SHA rehearsal succeeds; inspect tag, Release, named assets, release-digests correlation, and a clean future-adopter installation before reporting success.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The release eligibility check identifies v0.5.55 as the sole next patch after public v0.5.54 on synchronized origin/main.
A same-SHA v0.5.55 rehearsal succeeds without creating a tag, provider Release, or public asset and produces a receipt bound to that source/tag tuple.

The actual release workflow consumes only that successful rehearsal receipt, creates v0.5.55, and verifies the immutable tag target, provider Release, named assets, archive hash, SBOM, provenance, and release-digests correlation.

After publication, main/release.json has releaseTag v0.5.55 and release-state.json has releaseTag v0.5.56 with previousRelease v0.5.55; the public default discovery URL returns v0.5.55 rather than v0.5.54.

A clean Git repository invoking the public raw v0.5.55 installer after default discovery receives releaseTag v0.5.55, sourceCommit ef000c8cac2346cf349b8b5bdef5fb672f4d2b45, archive SHA-256 2ebc8299488a4f89d20bdb31f742619d4d0d1907aee0dcb1c16816d5dd83d2f1, and a matching release-digests manifest.
The Work Item ends with truthful Outcome evidence, completes PR/merge/closure, and leaves no local or remote Work Item branch.
guidelines: Do not bypass release.yml or manually mutate immutable release objects.
Keep published projection, canonical release state, provider release assets, and future-adopter facts distinguishable and source-bound.
Do not claim a version is published until tag, stable provider Release, named assets, and clean installation are all verified.

intent.problem: The performance capability has been merged and proven, but it does not benefit future adopter projects until it is delivered through a new trustworthy public release. Past release-digests/version inconsistencies made it difficult for installers to know which version to trust.
constraints: Publish exactly the next eligible patch, v0.5.55, from the latest synchronized origin/main source, then synchronize the default published projection to that immutable release and prepare only v0.5.56 as a future candidate.
Preserve v0.5.50 and every prior immutable release unchanged.
Require same-SHA rehearsal, provider release evidence, and independent clean installation; do not turn a fast or partial run into success.
No weakening of quality, coverage, security, release, installer, or failure-evidence gates.
Close the Work Item and clean its local and remote branch after merge.
intent.rationale: A public release backed by exact source-bound assets and a clean installer proof is the only reliable way to deliver the measured performance improvement to projects installed in the future; the default discovery projection must also name that published release.

rawUserRequest: 目标是把收益交付给 adopter。不是现成已有的具体某个项目，是未来安装的对象工程。到发布最新版本为止，做好优化和自检。明天，我要看到修正完整的新版本（包括远程和本地的清理）。完成全部工单为止不要停。要确认的，我授权给你，并写入contract。

authorityEvidence.scope: Publish only v0.5.55 after mandatory readiness, exact-source rehearsal, controlled release workflow, immutable tag, provider assets, future-adopter installation verification, and final Work Item cleanup pass. No gate bypass, historical-tag mutation, or blind retry is authorized.

declaredIntent.summary: Deliver the merged quality-critical-path performance capability to future adopter projects through a single verified public v0.5.55 release.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized complete publication, provider-side verification, future-adopter installation proof, and cleanup.

rollbackNote: Do not alter an immutable tag or published Release. If rehearsal or publication validation fails, retain its evidence, leave it unpublished or quarantined as the workflow requires, repair through a successor Work Item, and advance to a new patch only when required.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Dispatch release.yml rehearsal, inspect receipt, then independently query tag and provider Release absence.
